segments.name: South Deep
segments.description: Underground gold mine in South Africa, producing and selling gold from combined surface and underground operations.
segments.evidence: Gold mining operations are managed and internally reported based on the following geographical areas: in South Africa, South Deep mine, in Ghana, Tarkwa and Damang mines, in Australia, St Ives, Agnew, Granny Smith and Gruyere, in Peru, the Cerro Corona mine and in Chile, Salares Norte.

segments.name: Tarkwa

revenueModel.text: Gold Fields is paid by customers for the gold, copper and silver it mines and sells.
revenueModel.evidence: Includes revenue from the sale of copper and silver amounting to US $ 228.1 million and US $ 116.7 million , respectively.

changes.text: Gold Fields divested its Asanko Gold shareholding, announced in 2023 and completed in 2024.
changes.evidence: On 21 December 2023, Gold Fields announced the divestment of its 45% shareholding in Asanko Gold to the joint venture partner Galiano Gold.

changes.text: The Gruyere mine moved from a half share to full ownership after the 2025 acquisition of Gold Road.
changes.evidence: Results are reported on a 50% basis up to the acquisition of Gold Road on 26 September 2025 and on a 100% basis from that date forward.
